headline: YouTube adds AI custom feeds and new comment tools
summary: YouTube is rolling out custom feeds that let users describe what they want to see, built with Gemini, along with GIF replies, voice-powered TV comments, personalized moderation, and paid members-only communities. Outlets differ on whether these AI features are arriving now or are still mostly to come later this year.

claims.statement: YouTube is introducing custom feeds that let users describe what they want to see, built using Gemini.

discrepancies.explanation: Wired describes the custom-feeds rollout as part of YouTube's latest update, while Ars Technica frames much of the AI push as still to come later this year.
